slides.title: What Does Phillips 66 Do?
slides.text: Phillips 66 operates across four segments. Refining is the core — 1.8 million barrels per day at 99% utilization, among the best in class. Midstream is the growth engine, on track for $4.5 billion in EBITDA through NGL and pipeline assets. Chemicals contributes via a 50% stake in CPChem, one of the world's largest petrochemical JVs. Marketing & Specialties rounds it out with fuel distribution and lubricants.

Phillips 66 beat Q4 2025 earnings — $2.47 vs $2.15 estimated. That's 3 consecutive quarterly beats. Management execution has been strong, and the street is starting to price in operational consistency.
